name: 27527-docpage-dsocr2-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE -- deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR is a different model end to end. 6.78 GB of bf16, public and ungated.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekOCR2ForCausalLM, ~3.4 B parameters: a SAM-ViT-B vision tower in front of a 12-layer DeepSeek-V2-style MoE language model; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4 as a seed value that may be walked. Warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, one turn, ONE image per request: a 1280x1920 gradient JPEG at quality 85 and a 16-token instruction in, 32 tokens out, both lengths fixed with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. The page is 857 of the ~873 input tokens. HOLD THE RESOLUTION FIXED: the engine raises when two images in one batch cut into different numbers of 640x640 crops, so a run that varies it does not start.
purpose: A document page reader extracting text from one fixed-resolution scan per request, short answers, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving DeepSeek-OCR-2, four document-page requests in flight.
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2
tp-size: 1
enable-multimodal: true

# PINNED RATHER THAN INFERRED: the chat-template resolver's answer depends on whether the model is
# named by hub id or by a local snapshot directory, and the directory answer is the wrong template.
chat-template: deepseek-ocr

# Every request carries its own distinct page; nothing may be reused between requests.
disable-radix-cache: true

# host / port / served-model-name are owned by the launcher; everything else is stock.
